limits: Dedicated released-binary cases, ordinary native ARM64 and strict x86 Clippy qualify only the exact named head and tested merge.
Schedule release6408 and6498 executable payloads are byte-identical; no Schedule implementation-delta claim.
Tasks uses fake Harness and Voice. Completion remains unverified. Explicit Tasks/held-backend cut reaps do not independently enumerate every transient subprocess.
Voice uses real released delivery-ledger consumers with authored Schedule API and completion events. No physical speech or audio.
Synthetic boot identifiers and trust flags are not a physical reboot, real provider, updater installation or power-loss durability test.
CI fixtures verified release pins before/after; this audit verified retained metadata and archive/state bytes, without independently redownloading executable releases.
Raw identity-bearing API objects, full workflow logs, archives and executable payloads are retained privately; only derived safe metadata and case text are selected for publication.
The ordinary nextest total includes one LEAK-marked pass; its captured nested output is not counted again. Skipped names are not listed in the run log.
